description: AsyncAPI operation, message, reply-message, and protocol-cell accounting.

scenarios.description: A publish target remains represented while every governing message, reply message, and effective server/protocol cell receives a disposition. Under the routed-envelope ruling (2026-08-14) a message alternative declaring headers is REPRESENTED: declared headers are application data riding the envelope beside the payload, no longer an asyncapi.message_headers exclusion, so this cell is fully represented.
An unincorporated AsyncAPI edition is refused rather than accepted by major-line inference.
A reply-bearing send synthesizes both application directions independently of installed driver capability.
A reply declared as a Reference Object into components.replies synthesizes identically to the inline reply form, including the declared reply-message identity.

An artifact whose payload schemas use Draft-07 spellings the OBI dialect changed (tuple items, additionalItems, dependencies, a declared $schema) synthesizes fully represented: Schema Objects enter OBI positions under semantic-preserving dialect translation, never verbatim copy and never whole-artifact refusal.

Declared binary media (application/octet-stream) is invocable through the artifact-authorized byte rule (ruled 2026-08-13): exact octets cross the boundary as the canonical Base64 string. This artifact's author declared exactly the boundary schema ({type: string, contentEncoding: base64}), so nothing is lost and the artifact is fully represented. Consumer codec hooks are the enrichment path to logical values; a declared contract that differs from the boundary schema accounts lossy instead (ASYNC-SS-19).

An AsyncAPI 3 Multi Format Schema Object declaring the Avro schema format crosses the boundary as logical application values under the named Avro correspondence (ruled 2026-08-14): the direction's schema derives from the Avro schema as the JSON Schema of its Avro-JSON-encoded data, and the artifact is fully represented — no longer lossy. (Formerly this cell pinned the pre-correspondence lossy accounting.)

An AsyncAPI 3 Multi Format Schema Object declaring the official JSON Schema Draft-07 media type unwraps to its schema member, which enters the OBI under dialect translation: the wrapper is never emitted as the schema (its schemaFormat/schema members are not 2020-12 vocabulary and would bury the real contract while validating as unconstrained), and the artifact is fully represented.

An operation declared in components.operations and referenced from the operations map synthesizes identically to the inline form: the operations-map entry resolves through the reference before the operation-object test, and the binding ref remains the operations-map pointer.

A channels-map entry declared as a Reference Object into components.channels synthesizes identically to the inline channel: message inventory, server effectivity, and coverage identity survive the spelling.
A channel message declared as a Reference Object into components.messages synthesizes identically to the inline message, and coverage retains the artifact's deepest declared message address.

A channel's servers subset (Reference Objects into the servers map) restricts the effective servers: only the referenced member appears as a server alternative, and a single effective server needs no configuration choice.
A message payload declared as a reference into components.schemas resolves before schema copy: the OBI carries the resolved, translated schema, never a dangling pointer.
A message trait supplying contentType merges before carriage evaluation: the trait-declared JSON content type keeps the direction fully represented rather than floored.

A payload referencing a self-recursive components schema synthesizes with the cycle hoisted into the operation schema's $defs and every surviving reference rewritten to point there: the recursion the artifact declared survives the projection, the emitted interface is valid (OBI-D-16), and the artifact is fully represented — never a whole-artifact refusal.

A payload declaration invalid under its own declared dialect (minimum: true is ill-formed in every accepted edition's Schema Object) is the artifact's defect, confined to exactly the affected operation (ASYNC-P-05): that target is invalid with asyncapi.payload_schema_invalid, its alternatives cascade, and the sibling operation synthesizes untouched — never a whole-artifact refusal.

prefixItems is not vocabulary in any accepted edition's default Schema Object, so the author's dialect ignored it; an empty array carried verbatim into 2020-12 would turn that inert annotation into an ill-formed keyword. Translation drops the empty spelling (preserving the declared no-op semantics exactly) and the artifact stays fully represented.

An artifact that declares no server at all still names a complete operation target (ASYNC-P-04, ruled 2026-08-13): a server is reachability, not identity. The operation synthesizes with a configuration.server requirement — never a synthesis exclusion — and invocation obtains the connection target through the CONTEXT_REQUIRED context negotiation before any observable dispatch.

Binary media with a declared Avro contract crosses the boundary as logical application values under the named Avro correspondence (ruled 2026-08-14): the schema derives from the Avro schema, the wire carries the Avro binary encoding through the qualified codec, and the artifact is fully represented. (Formerly this cell pinned the byte-boundary lossy accounting the correspondence supersedes.)

Avro named-type reuse: a record declares an enum inline and later fields reference it by name. The derivation materializes the named type once under the operation schema's $defs and every reference -- including references inside $defs members, which ride beside the derived root's own $ref -- rebases onto the operation pointer. The operation is fully represented; a synthesizer that leaves any derivation ref unrebased emits a dangling pointer and wrongly excludes the operation.

Channel parameters are operation input (ruled 2026-08-14, the amortization discriminator): a location-less parameter varies per invocation, so it rides the routed envelope as a caller-input field beside the payload, optional in the schema because configuration.address.parameters remains the amortized pre-fill. The receive operation's input is the envelope {payload (required), region}; the send (subscribe) operation gains a parameter-only input envelope -- addressing data is caller input even when no payload travels. Both targets are fully represented.

AsyncAPI 2.x Reference Object position admission: the 2.x Operation Object admits no Reference Object (publish/subscribe must be Operation Objects in every accepted 2.x edition), and the whole servers field is a Servers Object map, never a Reference Object. A document writing $ref at either position has no interpretation under its own declared edition and is refused whole-artifact BEFORE reference composition -- tolerating it and synthesizing a degraded OBI is the parser-tolerance divergence class the refusal converges (MC5 seal-1 finding F-V3-1).

AsyncAPI 2.x Reference Object position admission at a string-typed field: Channel Item description is typed `string` in every accepted 2.x edition, so a Reference Object there is not admitted and the document is refused whole-artifact before composition (the string-position cell of MC5 seal-1 finding F-V3-1).

A top-level Avro union: the Avro specification admits a JSON ARRAY as a complete schema, and the Multi Format Schema Object's schema member is untyped, so a union declared at the top level derives under the named Avro correspondence exactly like an interior union -- oneOf of the JSON Encoding's branches, null branch as the null schema, named branch under its single-key wrapper. The operation is fully represented; an implementation that demands an object schema at this position wrongly floors the direction as an inexpressible contract (the derivation cell of MC5 seal-1 finding F-V3-2).
